description: This file defines the ConceptDAO interface, which declares database access methods for concepts and related entities within the OpenMRS system. It includes operations for retrieving, saving, and deleting concepts, drug data, concept classes, mapping types, reference terms, and various concept attributes, as well as methods for searching and counting concepts based on diverse criteria.

methods.name: saveConcept

methods.description: Removes a concept from the database entirely.

methods.name: getConceptName
methods.description: Fetches a ConceptName entity based on its ID.

methods.name: getAllConcepts
methods.description: Returns all concepts, optionally sorted and filtered by retired status.

methods.name: getConcepts
methods.description: Searches for concepts matching given criteria, such as name, locale, classes, and datatypes.
